subject: SIG change request — redline sync & re-answer schedule
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudtrust.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudTrust SIG Team <sig@cloudtrust.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG v3 redlines: requested re-answers and diffs

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. CloudTrust just published SIG v3 and we ran it against your previously submitted answers. We identified a set of redlines where the control wording changed materially and a handful of answers appear to require substantive rework (not just mapping).

I attached a spreadsheet (SIG_v3_redlines.xlsx) that lists the affected control IDs, the prior answers we have on file, and our suggested delta text. For planning, can you: 
- Confirm whether Redwood will submit re-answers for the affected controls or provide a justification/exemption.
- Provide an estimated delivery date for a bulk re-answer batch and supporting evidence (audit logs, config screenshots, policy excerpts).

Target: we’re hoping to collect all re-answers and evidence by 2026-11-17 to keep the attestation timeline intact. If that date is not possible, please propose a feasible alternative and we’ll see if an extension is required.

Attachments: SIG_v3_redlines.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24 rows), sample_diff.txt (inline diff summary)

Thanks —
Samir
Samir Patel
CloudTrust — Partner Security
samir.patel@cloudtrust.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudtrust.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG v3 redlines: requested re-answers and diffs

Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and for the detailed spreadsheet. We’ll take ownership of a consolidated re-answer batch and evidence package. High-level plan below: 

1) Triage (today–Thu): Karthik will inventory controls with technical evidence needs. Maya will map which answers are only phrasing updates vs substantive policy/controls changes.
2) Re-answer pass (Fri–Mon): We’ll prepare a CSV of re-answers (reanswers_batch_1.csv) and a short commentary (redline_commentary.md) that explains any justifications/assumptions.
3) Evidence collection (Mon–Wed next week): Karthik will gather audit logs, config screenshots, and SOC references where applicable.
4) Delivery & diff summary (by 2026-11-17): We’ll upload the bundle and a single-sheet diff showing prior vs new answers; we can also provide a cleaned JSON if you prefer.

Open questions for you: 
- There are three control IDs in the sheet where your suggested delta includes a new data-retention clause. Can you confirm whether you need specific retention windows called out or if a policy-level statement plus an evidence artifact is sufficient?
- For controls referencing vendor attestations, do you need copies of the vendor SOCs or a summary (we can provide both).

If 11/17 is firm on your side, we’ll aim for that and flag any blockers early. Otherwise propose a one-week extension and we’ll adjust.

I’m putting Karthik & Maya on point and will run weekly syncs until close.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Manager, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudtrust.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG v3 redlines: requested re-answers and diffs

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick coordination. A couple clarifications that will help speed the re-answers: 

1) Retention wording: for the controls in column B (CTL-4.1, CTL-9.3, CTL-11.2) we need explicit retention windows where the control mentions "retention" — e.g., "retained for 7 years" or "retained for 90 days". A policy-only statement is insufficient for those three.

2) Audit logs: where you reference "audit logs" we need a sample extract (one month) and a short note about retention and tamper-resistance (where logs are shipped to immutable storage/S3 object lock or equivalent).

3) Vendor attestations: summary is fine for first pass; attach full SOC where possible for critical vendors.

If you can provide the retention windows and the sample extract by 2026-11-15, that will keep us on the 11/17 target.

Thanks —
On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 11:20 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudtrust.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG v3 redlines: requested re-answers and diffs

Samir —

Quick update and confirmed plan after internal triage: 

- Karthik will produce the sample audit extract (one-month) and document the retention/immutability posture by 2026-11-15.
- Maya will finalize the re-answers for the 24 rows in your sheet and include explicit retention windows for CTL-4.1, CTL-9.3, and CTL-11.2 (we’ll use the policy-approved windows of 90 days / 1 year / 7 years as appropriate).
- I’ll assemble the reanswers_batch_1.csv, the redline_commentary.md, and a diff spreadsheet and upload to your Drive link.

Attached: SIG_v3_redlines.xlsx (original), redline_sync_plan.docx (high-level owners/timeline), reanswers_batch_1.csv (placeholder — to be filled).

Can we set a 15-minute sync for 2026-11-16 10:00 AM PT to walk through any blockers? If that time doesn’t work, propose an alternate.

Thanks — we’ll loop in any engineering SMEs if we hit technical evidence gaps.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Manager, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: SIG_v3_redlines.xlsx (24 rows), redline_sync_plan.docx (1 page), reanswers_batch_1.csv (stub)
